subject: CORRECTION to my ack on the 20:30Z evidence failure: the result DID keep its output — cause is API integration test ECONNREFUSED, a port collision with the self-hosted runner
body: My ack on cloud-shared-surface-changed-scripts-mac-run-req said the failed result kept no output. Wrong: run-requests.mjs already records a 25-line redacted tail on every executed run, and my read had filtered that key out. The tail on mac/tick-20260925T203034Z says: 'API integration test crashed: [TypeError: fetch failed] ECONNREFUSED' → 'Preflight FAILED at: API integration test (boots the server)'. So no outputTail PR — that mechanism exists. Root cause, from the runner's own _diag: the self-hosted macOS runner ran jobs on this Mac 20:25:34–20:31:42Z and 20:39:41–20:50:50Z, i.e. straddling the 20:30:34Z tick's evidence run; both harnesses boot the api-server on the same fixed port, so the tick's test:api could not bind/reach its server. The 20:05Z and 20:55Z runs had no overlapping job and passed. Fix on my side, PR to follow: the tick's evidence run must not share a port with the runner (ephemeral port for the integration test, or the tick yields while a runner job is live). Nothing owed on mainline; readiness stands at 100%.
